name: Granary and loft (with the hoist and yard)
region: Bottom of the lane, beside the bakehouse, sick village

sensoryProfile.sight: A long blind wall of fieldstone, windowless; a hoist beam over a high door at cart-bed height 'a gallows arm'; big doors at the yard end barred from outside with a bar dropped into iron hasps, no lock; a low side door half-hidden behind a water butt, on leather hinges, unbarred; inside sacks stacked on low trestles row on row; a stair of bare planks without a rail up the inner wall to the loft; loft: a lamp on the boards, new pale clean sacks stacked to the roof-tree (one open, flour spilled in a white tongue), a floorboard lifted over a hole, a post, a clay jar the size of a baby's head sealed with waxed cloth.
sensoryProfile.sound: Planks creaking underfoot; a lid being prised; the arrow's 'hard flat smack'; oil spitting; the boy's scream; at the cage the iron door's scream.
sensoryProfile.smell: Grain dust, mouse, old sacking; under it the sweetness; in the loft the spilled jar: pears gone brown and the sharp wrongness of a struck flint.
sensoryProfile.touch: Dust in the air 'hanging, turning, lit gold by the lamp, midges over a pond' (flour dust, explosive); frost on the boards; the pressed blue shell.
sensoryProfile.atmosphere: The place where Millhaven's storehouse 'ended up': the staff grinds in the pull, 'one long pull' through the ash.

establishedFacts.fact: The keeper (Joss) drops the outer bar at supper; the lamp in the loft means someone came in by the unbarred side door.

Under a loft floorboard is a hidden clay jar of the built contamination; the loft holds most of the last load of the new man's flour, in new pale sacks stencilled ANDORHAL (a sheaf of wheat in a ring).

Jaina's blue shell ward on the spilled stuff holds till morning; Brask's men take the loft boards down at first light with the ice on them and burn them with the sacks and everything in the granary yard.
Fire: by the end, the granary and bakehouse are 'burned' (Sylvanas, night), the yard is a black steaming heap flattened by rain, a cart beside it with its shafts down.

eventsHere.event: By day Sylvanas questions Joss and Hob. At dusk the party enters; Tam is found at the lifted floorboard; the arrow, frost, shell; Brask arrives with torches; Tam taken to the cage. At night the yard fire; at dawn the heap.
